PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Consulting Engineer, Cisco

08/2022 – present | Bangalore, India

Indian Air Force – Network Automation (Air-Gapped): Implemented Python automation in an on-site air-gapped environment to detect configuration and service issues across BGP, IS-IS, OSPF, MPLS, and L3VPN, reducing troubleshooting time by 80%. •Microsoft Data Center – Data Center Network: Configured Cisco NCS540 routers, handling provisioning, hardware validation, OSPF testing, and reachability checks before production integration. •Reliance Jio – Network Migration & Automation: Migrated 500+ devices from Juniper and Huawei to NCS540, supporting IS-IS and BGP. Validated configurations and built Python-based pre/ post migration checks for 1000+ devices, reducing verification time by 90%. •NIC Guwahati – Hardware Validation and P2P testing: Performed NRFU and hardware testing of network devices and supported deployment and performance validation. •MTNL India – Migration: Supported migration of 100+ sites to ASR and NCS routers, assisting with troubleshooting and validation of BGP, MPLS, L2/ L3 VPN, and VRF services. •Railway Telecom – Network Design: Assisted in on-site network design in coordination with customers and solution architects. •MTN South Africa – Migration Documentation: Prepared MOP documents for large-scale, multi-site migrations involving 50 routers, covering VPN, MPLS, OSPF, and IS-IS, including pre-check and rollback procedures. •Core-42 – Deployment Automation: Automated document validation, NIP vs live configuration checks, and bulk configuration deployment, reducing rollout time by 90%. •Network Automation Tool (Cisco In-Built Tool): Planned automation of CRD, DDD, NIP, and NRFU workflows to reduce manual effort by 80% and standardize deployments. •Pre/Post Comparison Tool: Automated pre- and post-migration checks to compare router configurations, interface states, and BGP/ OSPF adjacencies. 01/2022 – 07/2022 | Bangalore, India

Technical Undergraduate Intern, Cisco

Completed technical training and assisted with configuration, testing, and basic troubleshooting of network devices across 5–10 routers under engineer supervision.

AI-ML virtual internship, AWS Academy

10/2021 – 12/2021 | Delhi, India

Trained & implemented AI-ML models through which we can solve real world problems.
